method: Native macOS UI actions, AX readback and screenshots through cua_repl
fixture: Generated local 30-second 960x540 24fps H264 test card, top-right ad text and bottom burned-in caption, no audio

cases.name: windowed_single_click_pause_resume
cases.observation: Canvas single click changed Pause to Play and held 5.5616s; second single click restored Pause and progress advanced to 12.8s.

cases.name: double_click_fullscreen_preserves_play
cases.observation: Double click entered fullscreen, sidebar absent, Pause remained and progress reached 20s.

cases.name: fullscreen_idle_and_hidden_canvas_pause
cases.observation: After restarting the test card and 3.5s idle, AX showed only video canvas. Single click revealed controls and paused at 18.040247125s.

cases.name: manual_ad_blur_and_burned_caption
cases.observation: Right-top AD example.test rectangle visibly blurred; lower SUBTITLES - KEEP THIS TEXT remained clear; paused position unchanged.

cases.name: ad_over_default_protection_rejected
cases.observation: Dragging an ad rectangle over lower caption showed 与字幕保护区重叠，整框不应用 and retained one existing ad region.

cases.name: new_protection_conflicts_existing_ad
cases.observation: Additional protection over existing ad disabled Apply and displayed conflict guidance.

cases.name: disable_restores_original
cases.observation: Disable showed sharp original AD example.test and caption, still paused.

cases.name: cancel_preserves_paused_state
cases.observation: Cancel conflicting draft preserved paused original state at 18.040247125s.

cases.name: cancel_restores_playing_state
cases.observation: Final binary: entered editor while playing, canceled, Pause button and advancing position confirmed resumed playback with previous cleanup.

cases.name: paused_first_frame_status_regression
cases.observation: Final binary after restart: Apply while paused immediately showed 960×540 → 3,840×2,160 · GPU 增强至 4K + 局部柔化（1框） and 已柔化 1 个区域; Play button and 22.330700833s remained.

binary_scope: First eight cases observed in release candidate before status-publication-only fix; last two and paused apply rerun on final binary after restart. No interaction or filter pixel code changed between candidates.
discovered_and_fixed: Paused first-frame metrics initially stayed 0x0/preparing due 0.5s publication throttle. First displayed or paused processed frames now publish immediately; native regression passed.
not_verified: All displays and aspect ratios in native UI
